description: azure_scale_mage default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (tone-mapped to the sheet's white-to-blue gradient; crystals and eyes as generated) baked onto the low (improved/textures/azure_scale_mage_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it; three GLOW regions carry the emission (Glow -> Emission Color): the eyes, the crystal cores, the crystal bodies

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the texture as baked. Sheet chips for reference: 38,42,63 / 54,72,130 / 117,141,203 / 185,198,230 / 234,222,213 / 110,105,111

eye_glow.note: the narrow intense blue eye (sheet eye pixels: brightest quarter 76..96,109..121,188..192, cores 116..126,207..209,255); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

crystal_core.note: the pale crystal cores (sheet L* > 65, b* < -40 pixels: median 127,165,249)

crystal_glow.note: the crystals' inner glow (sheet b* < -55 pixels: median 63,99,218), low so the faceted albedo still reads
